DateWire.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

description: Drawdown episode with start, valley, optional recovery, and max drawdown.

duration_days.description: Calendar days from start to end (or last observation).

end.description: Date when wealth recovered to the prior peak (None if still in drawdown).

max_drawdown.description: Maximum drawdown depth (negative fraction, e.g. −0.25 for a 25% loss).

near_recovery_threshold.description:
Near-recovery threshold: the drawdown level at which 99% of the
peak-to-trough loss has been recovered (i.e. `max_drawdown * 0.01`,
a value slightly below zero). Useful for identifying "almost recovered"
drawdowns where the series is within 1% of the prior peak.

start.description: Date when the drawdown began (peak date).

truncated_at_start.description:
`true` when the series began already in drawdown (no observed prior
peak), so `start` is the first observation rather than a true peak.
Survival / duration analytics should treat such episodes as
left-censored.

valley.description: Date of the maximum drawdown depth.

title: DrawdownEpisode
